items.question: Do I need to know how to code?
items.answer: No. The bootcamp is designed for people with no prior programming experience. You'll learn to use AI to write code for you.

items.question: What's the refund policy?
items.answer: If you're not satisfied after the first session, we'll refund 100% of your investment with no questions asked.

items.question: How much time should I dedicate per week?
items.answer: Live sessions are 75 minutes (3 times per week). We recommend dedicating 1-2 additional hours for practice.

items.question: Are sessions live or recorded?
items.answer: Sessions are 100% live with direct interaction. All sessions are recorded so you can review them whenever you want.

finalCTA.title: From consumer to creator in 2 weeks
finalCTA.description: The difference between those who try and those who succeed isn't talent. It's execution. VibeCoding gives you the tools, community, and system to go from idea to app in 14 days. No excuses. No "someday". No waiting for permission.
